name: block-unguarded-agent-spawn
displayName: Block Agents Started With Safety Off
description: Best effort. Refuses agents with safety off: claude --dangerously-skip-permissions, bypassPermissions, wildcard --allowedTools; codex --full-auto, --yolo, -a never, danger-full-access; gemini --yolo; cursor-agent --force; aider --yes-always; copilot --allow-all-tools; amp, cline, goose, opencode auto-approve; DeepSeek Harness 127.0.0.1:3080/api calls lifting sandbox/approvals (CVE-2026-82533). Sees through bash -c, sudo, npx. Misses: config, aliases, scripts, ssh, other dsh ports, file bodies. [Session-enforced in Cursor by a beforeShellExecution hook: a matched command is denied before it runs (witnessed blocking on Cursor, 2026-08-24). The hook needs git, a Python 3.11+ (python3, python or py; the Windows Store stub is skipped) and a usable bash resolved from PATH. The hook entry sets `failClosed`, which Cursor's hooks documentation (cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks) says blocks the action when the hook fails to run, so a hook that cannot start refuses the command. If the guard itself crashes, the hook returns `permission: "ask"`, which beforeShellExecution honours. Repo-wide enforcement at commit time and in CI still needs `chock sync`.]
